title: Eskiz sender choices
decision: A message Eskiz refuses is failed at once and not retried, so reminders are lost while the balance is empty and the shop still sees them as sent by SMS; any 2xx answer counts as sent; the token is renewed after 25 days and a refused sign-in pauses sign-ins for five minutes; no delivery callback is accepted, so sent means accepted by Eskiz; non-breaking spaces in amounts are replaced so Uzbek texts stay in the short alphabet; four templates must be registered with Eskiz; transient failures are retried by the outbox, which the wording of the specification on SMS did not foresee
context: Decided by an agent while building what the founder asked for on 2026-10-08; implemented and awaiting his review
rationale: Eskiz documents no error answers, so the mapping of failures is a reading by the agent and must be corrected after the first real ones
